neighbours.label: sentence- or clause-ending punctuation or a newline after a complete concrete statement ('.\n', newline, comma before a new clause)
fire:
We walked along the beach all morning and found three shells.
Lunch was at a small cafe.

The plumber fixed the leak under the sink.
He charged us forty dollars.
Maria painted the fence on Saturday, and her brother cut the grass.

My neighbor sold his old truck to a farmer.
The farmer drove it home.

Fresh Tomato Soup with Basil and Cream
A Simple Family Recipe
The bus to the airport leaves at noon, and it stops twice.

Add a colorful silk ribbon to your summer hat.
Gift cards are available in store.

The kids built a snowman behind the garage.
It melted by Tuesday.
